name: Question 12
worked_solution:
Using a cofactor expansion along the $3$rd column, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & 0 & -2 \\ -3 & 2 & 1 & -4 \\ -4 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 2 & 0 & -1\end{aligned}| & =0\cdot {C}_{13}+1\cdot {C}_{23}+0\cdot {C}_{33}+0\cdot {C}_{43} \\  & =1\cdot (-1)^{2+3}\cdot |\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & -2 \\ -4 & 3 & 1 \\ -1 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}| \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}1 & 5 & -2 \\ -4 & 3 & 1 \\ -1 & 2 & -1\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
